seo.title: Squirrel AI: adaptive learning - 24M students and a Guinness record (2024)
seo.meta_description: Squirrel AI, one-to-one adaptive learning in China, has supported more than 24 million students and set a Guinness record (112,718 students in a math lesson, 2024).
seo.resume_citable: Squirrel AI, a one-to-one adaptive learning system deployed in China, has supported more than 24 million students and set a Guinness record in September 2024 of 112,718 participants in an online math lesson, with mastery rising from 41.6% to 85.1% in synchronized learning.

faq.a: The system breaks each subject into thousands of fine-grained knowledge points, diagnoses the student's mastery, then generates an individualized path of exercises and remediation readjusted at each answer.
More than 24 million students supported in China according to the press, and a certified Guinness record of 112,718 participants in an online math lesson in September 2024.

pattern: one-to-one adaptive learning driven by fine-grained knowledge decomposition
objectif_business: Give each student a plan and one-to-one tutoring generated by the system, with efficiency higher than mass teaching, to run a network of centers and tablets at the scale of tens of millions of students in China.
description: Squirrel AI breaks each subject into thousands of fine-grained knowledge points, then diagnoses what the student masters and builds an individualized path. The system delivers exercises, explanations, and remediation one-to-one, continuously adapted to the answers. It is distributed through physical centers and tablets in China. In September 2024, Squirrel AI ran an online math lesson synchronizing more than 112,000 students, certified by Guinness World Records.
points_cles: One-to-one adaptive learning through fine-grained decomposition of knowledge points.
Proprietary system with a knowledge graph and knowledge tracing.
More than 24 million students, a Guinness record of 112,718 participants, mastery from 41.6% to 85.1%.
Evidence B, confirmed status (Time Best Inventions 2025, certified record 2024).

resultats.metrique: Guinness record - students in an online math lesson over 24h (Sept. 2024)
Students supported by the adaptive system (cumulative)

niveau_preuve.justification: Scale figures certified by Guinness World Records (September 2024 event) and reported by Time (Best Inventions 2025) and the World Economic Forum; learning gains documented by an academic study. Concordant sources, mostly official or third-party, hence evidence B.

stack_technique.detail: engine that diagnoses the student's mastery and generates the one-to-one path, exercise by exercise
decomposition of each subject into thousands of fine-grained knowledge points, built by the education team
continuous estimation of what the student masters, calibrated on the learning behaviors of more than 24 million students
distribution network: centers in more than 100 Chinese cities and dedicated learning tablets

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real time during the session; readjustment of the path at each student answer; retraining of the models on the base of accumulated behaviors.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Squirrel AI's AI/pedagogy team for the system; human supervisors in the centers for support and motivation.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The estimated mastery state of each knowledge point. If the diagnosis is wrong, the path proposes miscalibrated exercises and the promised efficiency collapses.

etapes.detail: The system assesses what the student masters across fine-grained knowledge points.
A path of exercises and explanations is generated to fill the detected gaps.
At each answer, the system readjusts the difficulty and the next content.
In the centers, supervisors sustain motivation and handle cases outside the model.

prerequis_data: fine-grained decomposition of the curriculum into knowledge points
history of student answers to estimate mastery
sufficient data volume to calibrate the adaptive model
prerequis_orga: education team to build the knowledge graph
data science team for knowledge tracing
distribution network (centers, tablets, or app) and compliance for minors' data
replication.equipe: 2-3 education experts + 2 data scientists + 1-2 devs + 1 DPO or lawyer for minors' data

playbook.action: Have the education team build the graph of fine-grained knowledge points on a pilot subject
Produce the exercise bank tagged on the graph and trace each student answer
playbook.livrable: Instrumented exercise platform, first answer data

playbook.action: Train the mastery model (knowledge tracing) on the accumulated answers
playbook.livrable: Mastery diagnosis evaluated against reference tests

playbook.action: Close the adaptive loop: generate the individualized path (next exercise, remediation) from the diagnosis
playbook.livrable: Adaptive engine piloted on a group of students

playbook.action: Add human support (motivation, cases outside the model) and compliance for minors' data, then extend to other subjects
playbook.livrable: Full setup measured on before/after progress

replication.premiere_etape: Break a subject into fine-grained knowledge points and instrument the answers, before connecting the adaptive engine.

statut_vivant.note: Recognized in Time's Best Inventions 2025; Guinness record of September 2024; network and system active in China. Chinese regulatory context for private tutoring to monitor.

transposable_ue.note: Adaptive learning on minors, with massive collection of behavioral data. In the EU, GDPR and the AI Act (education = high risk) would require data minimization, a clear legal basis, human oversight, and evaluation. The Chinese model of a physical network of centers is not directly transposable; the adaptive layer is.
